messages:
Aisha Kapoor: FYI — Sales asked for an exception on Veridian Health. They want Net60 + a one-time onboarding credit for initial months. Contract size ~ $180k ARR, pilot expected ~ $50k/mo. Need deal-desk + finance approval before I present terms. @Tom Barnes can you take a quick look?
Tom Barnes: Need numbers: what % credit, how many months, and is there a commitment term? Also flagging revenue recognition and aging impact.
Evan Li: They asked for 20% credit applied to first 3 months and Net60 on invoices. Procurement insists on Net60 for all vendors. They might be a high-value reference for healthcare. We can ask for a 12-month minimum commit.
Aisha Kapoor: Thanks. To recap: request = Net60 + 20% onboarding credit (first 3 months), conditional on 12-month commitment. Evan — confirm customer will sign 12 months if we push credit to 15% instead.
Evan Li: Quick update from call — customer prefers 15% but needs Net60. They said 12-month clause is acceptable if we add a data security addendum.
Tom Barnes: If we move to 15% (one-time) and require 12-month commit, that reduces the finance hit. Rough calc: 15% of first 3 months at $50k/mo = $22.5k credit (one-time). 20% would be $30k. CFO-level approval required for credits > $25k. Also Net60 increases DSO; need AP aging check.
Priya Nair: Legal: we'll need a signed addendum that includes payment terms and the security SOW. I'll prep a short amendment and a clause limiting similar exceptions to this single deal (no blanket Net60 for other customers).
deal-desk-bot: Request logged: DD-20260315-042. Queue: Pending finance calc + CFO sign-off.
Tom Barnes: Proposal from finance: Approve Net60 + 15% one-time onboarding credit, conditional on: (1) signed 12-month minimum commitment, (2) payment method = ACH or company PO with auto-invoice, (3) legal addendum signed, (4) CFO sign-off on credit > $20k. If all true, finance ops to set payment terms as Net60 in billing system and tag invoice for revenue team.
Aisha Kapoor: Sounds good. I'll route to CFO today and attach Priya's addendum once drafted. Evan — can you confirm customer ok with ACH/PO requirement?
Evan Li: Yes, they can provide PO + ACH fallback. I'll push for PO first thing tomorrow.
Priya Nair: Drafting addendum now. I'll include a clause: "Onboarding credit applied as one-time invoice adjustment; subject to pro-rated clawback if customer terminates before 12 months."
Tom Barnes: One more ask — finance ops: please validate we can apply a one-time invoice credit and still recognize revenue per standard policy. Tagging @finance-ops offline.
Aisha Kapoor: Thanks all. Next steps: Priya sends addendum, I route for CFO sign-off, Evan secures PO. Re-open here with CFO response. :thumbsup:
